cmd_setup_action_absent: Verb of a plan row of an uninstall: Atlas has nothing there to remove.
cmd_setup_action_conflict: Verb of a plan row: an entry Atlas did not create is in the way. Printed in capitals.
cmd_setup_action_create: Verb of a plan row in the dry run of `atlas setup`: a file or entry will be created. Padded to 13 columns.

cmd_setup_action_remove.description: Verb of a plan row in an uninstall dry run.
cmd_setup_action_remove.distinct: lowercase verb of a plan row, not the Remove button

cmd_setup_action_skipped: Verb of a plan row: a prerequisite is missing, so the row only reports.
cmd_setup_action_up_to_date: Verb of a plan row: nothing to change.
cmd_setup_action_update: Verb of a plan row in the dry run: an existing file or entry will be rewritten.
cmd_setup_applied_nothing_to_remove: Result of `atlas setup <agent> --uninstall --apply` when Atlas left nothing behind. A check mark comes before it.
cmd_setup_binary_unknown: Error of `atlas setup` when the path of the running atlas binary cannot be found.
cmd_setup_claude_mcp_invalid: Context of an error while the Claude Code MCP file is parsed.
cmd_setup_claude_settings_invalid: Context of an error while the Claude Code settings file is parsed.
cmd_setup_codex_config_invalid: Context of an error while the Codex config.toml is parsed.
cmd_setup_codex_hooks_invalid: Context of an error while the Codex hooks.json is parsed.
cmd_setup_command_not_on_path: Warning above the plan of `atlas setup <agent>` when the atlas binary is not found on PATH. {exe} is the path of the running binary.
cmd_setup_conflicts_refused: Error of `atlas setup <agent> --apply` when an entry that Atlas did not create is in the way.
cmd_setup_ctx_reading: Context of an error while `atlas setup` reads a config file.
cmd_setup_ctx_removing: Context of an error while `atlas setup --apply` removes a file or folder.
cmd_setup_ctx_running: Context of an error while `atlas setup --apply` starts a command.
cmd_setup_ctx_writing: Context of an error while `atlas setup --apply` writes a file.
cmd_setup_cwd_unreadable: Error of `atlas setup` when the working directory cannot be read.
cmd_setup_detect_found: Line of `atlas setup` for an installed coding agent. The agent name comes before it. {path} is the executable found on PATH.
cmd_setup_detect_install: Line under an agent in `atlas setup`: the command that applies the plan. {command} is in bold.
cmd_setup_detect_none: Last line of `atlas setup` when no coding agent is installed. {command} is `atlas setup <agent> --apply`, printed in bold.
cmd_setup_detect_not_found: Line of `atlas setup` for a coding agent whose executable is not on PATH. The agent name comes before it.
cmd_setup_detect_preview: Line under an agent in `atlas setup`: the command that only prints the plan. {command} is in bold.
cmd_setup_detect_status: Second line under an installed agent in `atlas setup`. {state} is one of the cmd_setup_state_* messages.
cmd_setup_detect_title: Heading of `atlas setup` without an agent: the report of which coding agents are installed. A diamond glyph comes before it.
cmd_setup_done_created: Verb of a plan row after `--apply`: the file or entry was created.
cmd_setup_done_removed: Verb of a plan row after `--apply`: the file or entry was removed.
cmd_setup_done_updated: Verb of a plan row after `--apply`: the file or entry was rewritten.
cmd_setup_dry_conflicts: Last line of the dry run of `atlas setup <agent>` when a foreign entry is in the way. A cross glyph comes before it.

cmd_setup_dry_nothing_to_remove.description: Last line of the dry run of `atlas setup <agent> --uninstall` when Atlas left nothing behind.
cmd_setup_dry_nothing_to_remove.distinct: a full sentence at the end of the dry run, the applied one is a status after a check mark

cmd_setup_dry_run: Last line of the dry run of `atlas setup <agent>`. {command} is the command that applies the plan, in bold.
cmd_setup_dry_up_to_date: Last line of the dry run of `atlas setup <agent>` when nothing would change. A check mark comes before it.
cmd_setup_exec_failed: Error of `atlas setup <agent> --apply` when a command it runs (omp plugin link) fails. {args} are its arguments, {status} the exit status text from the system.
cmd_setup_hooks_create_claude: Detail of the Hooks row for Claude Code when the hooks are created. The key names are Claude Code settings.
cmd_setup_hooks_create_codex: Detail of the Hooks row for Codex when the hooks are created.
cmd_setup_hooks_kept_claude: What survives in the Claude Code settings file after an uninstall. Used inside cmd_setup_hooks_removed_kept.
cmd_setup_hooks_kept_codex: What survives in the Codex hooks file after an uninstall. Used inside cmd_setup_hooks_removed_kept.
cmd_setup_hooks_removed_file: Detail of the Hooks row of an uninstall when the file held only atlas hooks, so it is deleted.
cmd_setup_hooks_removed_kept: Detail of the Hooks row of an uninstall. {kept} is cmd_setup_hooks_kept_claude or _codex.
cmd_setup_hooks_update_claude: Detail of the Hooks row for Claude Code when the hooks are rewritten.
cmd_setup_hooks_update_codex: Detail of the Hooks row for Codex when the hooks are rewritten.
cmd_setup_json_event_not_array: Error when one event of the hooks key of a settings file has the wrong type. {event} is the event name.
cmd_setup_json_hooks_not_object: Error when the hooks key of a settings file has the wrong type.
cmd_setup_json_not_object: Error when a config file is JSON but not an object.
cmd_setup_json_servers_not_object: Error when the mcpServers key of an MCP config has the wrong type.
cmd_setup_label_hooks: Name of a plan row: the atlas hooks in the settings file of the agent.
cmd_setup_label_legacy_hook: Name of a plan row: the hook file that older Atlas versions wrote for omp.
cmd_setup_label_mcp: Name of a plan row: the atlas entry in the MCP config of the agent.
cmd_setup_label_plugin: Name of a plan row: the atlas plugin files of omp or OpenCode.
cmd_setup_label_plugin_link: Name of a plan row: the link between the omp plugin folder and omp.
cmd_setup_label_skills: Name of a plan row: the bundled skills installed for the agent.
cmd_setup_label_skills_shared: Name of a plan row: the bundled skills in the folder that omp and Codex share.
cmd_setup_mcp_conflict: Detail of the MCP row when the config already has an atlas entry that Atlas did not write. {current} is that entry. Two lines.
cmd_setup_mcp_foreign: Detail of the MCP row of an uninstall when the atlas entry is not Atlas's.
cmd_setup_mcp_note_claude: End of the detail of the MCP row for Claude Code when the entry is updated.
cmd_setup_mcp_note_codex: End of the detail of the MCP row for Codex when the entry is updated.
cmd_setup_mcp_removed_file: Detail of the MCP row of an uninstall: the file held only the atlas entry, so it is deleted. {key} is the config key.
cmd_setup_mcp_removed_kept: Detail of the MCP row of an uninstall: only the atlas entry goes. {key} is the config key.
cmd_setup_next_steps: Heading of the numbered list printed after `atlas setup <agent> --apply`.
cmd_setup_omp_legacy_foreign: Detail of the Legacy hook row of an uninstall when the hook file is not Atlas's. {marker} is the header text Atlas writes.
cmd_setup_omp_legacy_replaced: Detail of the Legacy hook row: the plugin brings its own hook.
cmd_setup_omp_link_missing: Detail of the Plugin link row when omp is not installed. {command} is `omp plugin link <dir>`.
cmd_setup_omp_list_failed: Error when `omp plugin list --json` fails. {status} is the exit status text from the system.
cmd_setup_omp_list_invalid: Error when the output of `omp plugin list --json` cannot be parsed.
cmd_setup_omp_list_timeout: Error when `omp plugin list --json` does not finish in 5 seconds.
cmd_setup_omp_mcp_invalid: Context of an error while omp's legacy MCP file is parsed.
cmd_setup_omp_no_stdout: Error when `omp plugin list --json` has no stdout pipe.
cmd_setup_omp_project_warning: Warning above the plan of `atlas setup omp --scope project`.
cmd_setup_omp_restart_warning: Warning above the plan of `atlas setup omp`.
cmd_setup_omp_run_failed: Context of an error when `omp plugin list --json` cannot start. {omp} is the omp executable.
cmd_setup_opencode_absent: Detail of the Plugin row for OpenCode on uninstall when the file is absent.
cmd_setup_opencode_conflict: Detail of the Plugin row for OpenCode when the file is not Atlas's.
cmd_setup_opencode_create: Detail of the Plugin row for OpenCode when the plugin file is created.
cmd_setup_opencode_forced: Detail of the Plugin row for OpenCode with --force.
cmd_setup_opencode_foreign: Detail of the Plugin row for OpenCode on uninstall when the file is not Atlas's.
cmd_setup_opencode_removed: Detail of the Plugin row for OpenCode on uninstall.
cmd_setup_opencode_up_to_date: Detail of the Plugin row for OpenCode when nothing changes.
cmd_setup_opencode_update: Detail of the Plugin row for OpenCode when the plugin file is rewritten.
cmd_setup_project_root_missing: Error when the project scope of an agent is resolved outside an Atlas project.
cmd_setup_project_user_only: What `atlas setup opencode --scope project` would write: nothing, because OpenCode plugins are global.
cmd_setup_refreshed: Line printed by `atlas update` when it rewrote the hooks of an agent. An arrow glyph comes before it. {path} is the file or folder rewritten.
cmd_setup_removal_restart: Line after `atlas setup <agent> --uninstall --apply`. {label} is the agent label.
cmd_setup_scope_banner: Dim text at the end of the heading of `atlas setup <agent>`. {scope} is cmd_setup_scope_user or cmd_setup_scope_project.
cmd_setup_scope_project: Scope of `atlas setup <agent> --scope project`. {root} is the Atlas project folder, {what} the files the agent reads there.
cmd_setup_scope_project_missing: Error of `atlas setup <agent> --scope project` run outside an Atlas project. {dir} is the current folder. i18n-allow glossary:project (the flag value).
cmd_setup_scope_user: Scope of `atlas setup <agent>` at user level. {dir} is the agent config folder.
cmd_setup_skills_detail: Detail of the Skills row. {names} lists the skills, {version} is the atlas version, {missing} how many are not installed yet, {outdated} how many differ.
cmd_setup_skills_kept: Detail of the Skills row of an uninstall when the skills stay. {reason} is cmd_setup_skills_kept_reason.
cmd_setup_skills_kept_reason: Why the shared skills stay on uninstall. {label} is the other agent (OMP or Codex) that still uses them. i18n-allow glossary:agent (the folder name ~/.agents).
cmd_setup_skills_user_warning: Warning above the plan of `atlas setup <agent> --scope project`. {dir} is the user skills folder, {harness} the agent label.
cmd_setup_state_attention: Status of an installed agent in `atlas setup`: the plan has a conflict with a foreign entry.
cmd_setup_state_error: Status of an installed agent in `atlas setup` when its config file cannot be read or parsed. {error} is the reason.
cmd_setup_state_ok: Status of an installed agent in `atlas setup`: Atlas is wired in and nothing would change.
cmd_setup_state_outdated: Status of an installed agent in `atlas setup`: Atlas is not wired in yet, or the files differ from this Atlas version.
cmd_setup_steps_claude_restart: Step 1 after setting up Claude Code.
cmd_setup_steps_claude_verify: Step 2 after setting up Claude Code. {command} is `claude mcp get atlas`, {slash} is /mcp, both in bold. Connected is the word the Claude Code CLI prints and stays in English.
cmd_setup_steps_codex_restart: Step 1 after setting up Codex. {command} is the slash command /hooks, in bold.
cmd_setup_steps_codex_verify: Step 2 after setting up Codex. {command} is `codex mcp get atlas`, {slash} is /mcp, in bold.
cmd_setup_steps_omp_restart: Step 1 after setting up omp. {command} is the slash command /reload-plugins, in bold.
cmd_setup_steps_omp_verify: Step 2 after setting up omp. {mcp} and {plugins} are commands to run, in bold.
cmd_setup_steps_status_hint: Last step after setting up omp, Claude Code or Codex.
cmd_setup_title_install: Heading of `atlas setup <agent>`. {label} is the agent label.
cmd_setup_title_uninstall: Heading of `atlas setup <agent> --uninstall`. {label} is the agent label.
cmd_setup_toml_servers_not_table: Error when the MCP servers key of the Codex config.toml has the wrong type. {key} is the key.
